fsa.experience: FSA counts a beginning farmer as anyone under ten years in. The direct farm ownership loan wants three years in the business of a farm out of the last ten; a year as a hand with real management duties, a farm management course, military service, or a mentor through SCORE can each stand in for a year of it, and the hand year plus a mentor together waive the rule. Operating loans and microloans ask for less. Write your years down with dates and the men you worked for.
